en.bdb: As the seed puts in the earth gives fruit thousand times more.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਵਾਇ ਨ ਲੇਖ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh mukh pavai na lekh likhaiaa|

en.bdb: The food put in the mouth of a gurmukh multiplies infinitely and its count becomes impossible.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇਇ ਫਲਾਇ ਜੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee dhei falai joiee fal paiaa|

en.bdb: The earth gives the fruit of the seed sowed in it;

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੁਖਿ ਸਮਾਇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਲਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh mukh samai sabh fal laiaa|

en.bdb: But the seed it offered to Guru oriented ones gives all sorts of fruits.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੀਜੇ ਬਾਝੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ਨ ਧਰਤਿ ਜਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: beeje baajh na khai na dharat jamaiaa|

en.bdb: Without sowing, neither anyone could eat anything nor the earth can produce anything;
Having the desire of serve the Gurmukh, fulfils all desires.
